say:1:1231180001:1.text: Ah, I must have been mistaken.

say:2:1231180002:1.text: But I've been in Rustport so long, I know everyone on this side of town.
say:2:1231180002:1.source_cn: 可是我在锈锚港这么久，港口这边的人我都认识。

say:3:1231180003:1.text: And you, if you'll excuse my forwardness, don't look all too familiar.
say:3:1231180003:1.source_cn: 而你，恕我冒昧，我好像确实从未见过你。
say:3:1231180003:1.male: And you, if you'll excuse my forwardness, don't look all too familiar.
say:3:1231180003:1.female: And you, if you'll excuse my forwardness, don't look all too familiar.
